met_analysis:
The Monsoon trough at mean sea level continue to pass through Sri Ganganagar, Rohtak, Hardoi, Sultanpur, Ranchi, Baleshwar and thence southeastwards towards Northwest Bay of Bengal and extends upto 0.9 km above mean sea level.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over Punjab & neighbourhood extending upto 1.5 km above mean sea level persists.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over central parts of south Uttar Pradesh at 3.1 km above mean sea level persists.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over North Jharkhand and adjoining Bihar extending upto 1.5 km above mean sea level persists.
The trough from the above upper air cyclonic circulation over North Jharkhand and adjoining Bihar to Tripura across north Gangetic West Bengal and Bangladesh extending upto 1.5 km above mean sea level persists.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over southwest Rajasthan & neighbourhood between 3.1 & 4.5 km above mean sea level persists.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over Westcentral Bay of Bengal & adjoining north Coastal Andhra Pradesh between 5.8 & 7.6 km above mean sea level persists.
The trough from the above upper air cyclonic circulation over Westcentral Bay of Bengal & adjoining north Coastal Andhra Pradesh to Northeast Arabian sea across south Odisha, south Chhattisgarh, Telangana, Marathwada, Madhya Maharashtra and south Gujarat Region at 5.8 km above mean sea level persists.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over Central Assam & adjoining Nagaland between 1.5 & 3.1 km above mean sea level persists.
